bio.text: Kris Kobach, a Republican, is the Kansas Attorney General and the incumbent candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Chris Mann.
He was elected attorney general in 2022, and according to his campaign website he previously served as Kansas Secretary of State from 2011 to 2019.
The website says he was raised in Topeka, graduated from Harvard University, received a Ph.D. in politics from the University of Oxford and a J.D. from Yale Law School.

It also says he was a constitutional law professor at the University of Missouri-Kansas City, a White House Fellow, and Counsel to the Attorney General at the U.S. Department of Justice, and that he lives near Lecompton.

sources.title: Who's running for Kansas attorney general? A familiar showdown between Kobach and Mann
sources.publisher: The Lawrence Times / Kansas News Service
